description: This Java enum defines different versions of JSON schemas, providing utilities to identify, compare, and work with schema version identifiers in JSON fields.

classes.name: JsonSchemaVersion
classes.description: An enumeration of JSON schema versions that implements Predicate<JsonField> to identify schema version fields, and provides utility methods such as mapping integer versions and retrieving the latest version.

methods.name: getJsonKey
methods.description: Returns the JSON key used to identify schema version fields in JSON objects.

methods.name: forInt
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the JsonSchemaVersion corresponding to the given integer version, or empty if none matches.

methods.name: toInt
methods.description: Returns the integer representation of the schema version.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Checks if a given JsonField matches this schema version's marker predicate.
